title: WildGuard: Open One-Stop Moderation Tools for Safety Risks, Jailbreaks, and Refusals of LLMs
authors_zh: Seungju Han、Kavel Rao、Allyson Ettinger、Liwei Jiang、Bill Yuchen Lin、Nathan Lambert、Yejin Choi、Nouha Dziri
paper_type_zh: 后训练数据、偏好、奖励或评测研究
best_for_zh: 研究 LLM 后训练反馈数据与 verifier 的读者。
one_line: WildGuard: Open One-Stop Moderation Tools for Safety Risks, Jailbreaks, and Refusals of LLMs addresses open moderation tools for safety risks and jailbreaks.
发布 WildGuardMix 安全审核数据和 WildGuard 模型，用统一标签识别有害意图、回答风险、拒答与越狱攻击。
why: It exposes a feedback, preference, reward, rubric, safety, or post-training data surface that must be audited before reuse.
inclusion_reason: Candidate paper on open moderation tools for safety risks and jailbreaks with an official arXiv primary link.

title: Problem
问题
html: WildGuard addresses a moderation gap that is often hidden by a single binary “safe” label. A deployed assistant needs to distinguish whether a user prompt expresses harmful intent, whether a generated response contains unsafe material, and whether the assistant appropriately refused. Jailbreak prompts make the distinction operationally important: a prompt may be adversarial without itself being a harmful answer, while an overbroad refusal can be safe but unhelpful. The paper frames moderation as a multi-task, policy-dependent decision problem rather than a generic toxicity classifier.
《WildGuard》针对一个常被“安全/不安全”二元标签掩盖的审核缺口：部署中的助手既要判断用户提示是否表达有害意图，也要判断生成回复是否含有风险，还要判断助手是否作出了恰当拒答。越狱提示使三者的差异具有直接工程意义——对抗性提示未必本身就是有害回答，过宽的拒答又可能安全却没有帮助。论文将审核界定为受策略约束的多任务决策，而非通用的毒性分类。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is an open, unified moderator trained to make prompt-harmfulness, response-harmfulness, and refusal judgments with shared representations and explicit task outputs. Its central data asset, WildGuardMix, combines 92K labelled examples spanning direct requests and adversarial jailbreaks across 13 risk categories. The feedback contract is three-way: given a prompt, judge intent; given a response, judge generated risk; given the interaction, judge whether the response is a refusal. A product must still set thresholds, policies, and escalation paths outside the model.
核心贡献是一个开放的统一审核器：用共享表征分别输出提示有害性、回复有害性和拒答判断。其数据资产 WildGuardMix 含 9.2 万条标注样本，覆盖 13 类风险中的直接请求与对抗性越狱。反馈契约有三层：给定提示判断意图；给定回复判断生成风险；给定整段交互判断回复是否拒答。产品仍须在模型之外规定阈值、策略和人工升级路径。

title: Method
方法
html: WildGuard is trained from WildGuardMix and evaluated on WildGuardTest, a 5K human-labelled test set, plus ten public moderation benchmarks. The dataset construction deliberately includes ordinary prompts, harmful requests, refusal-like responses, compliant harmful responses, and jailbreak-shaped inputs so that the three labels cannot be solved merely by keyword spotting. A reproducible record should retain the prompt, response, source or generation route, risk taxonomy label, each of the three target labels, annotator protocol or synthesis method, split, language, and policy version. Input formatting matters because prompt-only, response-only, and paired judgments expose different evidence.

WildGuard 在 WildGuardMix 上训练，并在含 5,000 条人工标注样本的 WildGuardTest 及十个公开审核基准上评估。构造时同时放入普通提示、有害请求、类似拒答的回复、顺从性的有害回复及越狱形态输入，避免模型只凭关键词完成三项任务。可复现实例需保留提示、回复、来源或生成路径、风险分类、三项目标标签、标注协议或合成方式、数据切分、语言和策略版本；提示单独、回复单独和成对输入会暴露不同证据，格式不能随意替换。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports that WildGuard is competitive with or exceeds compared open moderators across the multi-task evaluation, including up to a 26.4% improvement in refusal detection and up to a 3.9% prompt-harmfulness improvement over GPT-4 in the reported comparison. It also studies a deployed protection setting in which the measured jailbreak success rate drops from 79.8% to 2.4%. These are evaluation-bound results, not a guarantee that every future attack is blocked: attack generator, policy, model, interface, threshold, and the definition of success must match before comparing numbers.
论文报告 WildGuard 在多任务比较中相对开放审核器具有竞争力或优势：所述设定下，拒答识别最高提升 26.4%，提示有害性相对 GPT-4 最高提升 3.9%。它还研究了一个保护式部署设定，测得越狱成功率从 79.8% 降至 2.4%。这些均是受评测边界限制的结果，而非对未来攻击一概阻断的保证；攻击生成器、策略、被保护模型、界面、阈值和“成功”的定义均需一致才可比较。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The direction signal is the unification of content moderation and refusal quality. Earlier tools frequently score only prompt danger or response toxicity; WildGuard makes the frequent operational failure “the system refused when it should answer” measurable alongside “the system answered when it should refuse.” The work is not a universal safety policy, a formal proof of jailbreak robustness, or a substitute for human review in high-impact decisions. Its taxonomy and labels encode specific normative choices.
方向性新意在于把内容审核与拒答质量统一度量。很多既有工具只评提示危险或回复毒性；WildGuard 使两种常见运行失败都可测量：该拒却回答，以及本可回答却拒答。论文并非通用安全策略、越狱鲁棒性的形式证明，也不能替代高影响决策中的人工审查。其风险分类和标签本身承载了特定的规范取舍。

title: Limitations
局限
html: A classifier trained on a fixed taxonomy can miss emerging harms, indirect intent, multilingual pragmatics, or attacks that do not resemble its synthetic and collected sources. Refusal labels are especially value-laden: concise boundary-setting, partial safe completion, redirection, and policy explanation may be judged differently by users and annotators. Aggregate scores can hide false refusals for benign users and false negatives on rare harms. Audit confusion matrices by category, language, prompt length, adversarial family, and task; red-team against adaptive attackers rather than treating one benchmark pass as security assurance.
固定风险分类训练出的模型可能遗漏新型伤害、间接意图、多语用法或不像训练来源的攻击。拒答标签尤其带有价值判断：简短设边界、部分安全完成、重定向与解释策略，用户和标注者可能评价不同。总体分数还会掩盖良性用户的误拒和罕见伤害的漏放。应按风险类别、语言、提示长度、攻击家族和任务分别审计混淆矩阵，并用自适应红队持续检验，不能把一次基准通过当作安全保证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use WildGuard as a transparent first-stage moderator, a dataset for training or evaluating multi-task safety judges, or a regression suite for refusal behavior after assistant changes. It is most useful when its scores feed a documented policy: allow, refuse safely, transform to a safe alternative, send to a higher-cost reviewer, or log for review. It should not silently become the sole arbiter for legal, medical, employment, or other high-stakes user outcomes, nor should a safety score be presented as an explanation of policy correctness.
可将 WildGuard 用作透明的第一阶段审核器、训练或评估多任务安全裁判的数据集，或在助手改动后的拒答回归套件。当分数接入明确的策略链时最有价值：放行、恰当拒答、改写为安全替代、升级给高成本审核或记录复核。它不应悄然成为法律、医疗、雇佣等高风险结果的唯一裁决者，也不应把安全分数包装成策略正确性的解释。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: For replication, pin the released code, model checkpoint, WildGuardMix revision, taxonomy, and prompt templates; run prompt, response, and interaction evaluations separately before reporting a combined headline. Reproduce the ten-benchmark protocol only after checking split leakage and whether a benchmark's labels match WildGuard's policy. For an integration test, freeze a representative traffic sample, set thresholds on a development set, measure benign refusal rate and harmful pass rate, then rerun an adaptive jailbreak suite after every prompt, model, or policy change.
复现时应固定发布代码、模型检查点、WildGuardMix 版本、风险分类和提示模板；先分开运行提示、回复与交互评估，再报告综合结论。复现十基准协议前，要检查切分泄漏以及基准标签是否真的匹配 WildGuard 的策略。集成测试可冻结代表性流量，在开发集设阈值，测量良性误拒率与有害漏放率，并在每次提示、模型或策略变更后重跑自适应越狱套件。
